# Amres

> > Amres is a customer-focused mortgage lender offering diverse loan programs including FHA, Non-QM, and refinancing solutions through a nationwide network of loan officers.

Founded in 2015, Amres provides residential mortgage lending services with a hybrid lending model that combines personalized service with comprehensive educational resources. The company operates across multiple states including Illinois, Pennsylvania, and Texas, serving homebuyers and homeowners through experienced loan officers like Oren Barzeski, Emrakh Akhmedov, and Steve Phras.
